items.title: 「太糟糕了」：關稅、燃油成本飆升和利率上升如何擠壓美國公司
items.titleEn: ‘It's awful’: How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies
items.titleZh: 「太糟糕了」：關稅、燃油成本飆升和利率上升如何擠壓美國公司
items.summaryEn: Tariffs, fuel prices and interest rates are squeezing American companies, particularly manufacturers, auto suppliers, retailers and transportation businesses.
items.summaryZh: 關稅、燃料價格和利率正在擠壓美國公司的生存空間，尤其是製造商、汽車供應商、零售商和運輸企業。

items.title: 英偉達執行長黃仁勳成為川普在人工智慧安全辯論中的主要盟友

items.title: 川普稱他將禁止MS NOW、CNN和Politico進入白宮。
items.titleEn: Trump says he's banning MS NOW, CNN and Politico from White House
items.titleZh: 川普稱他將禁止MS NOW、CNN和Politico進入白宮。
items.summaryEn: Trump, who often accuses mainstream media outlets of writing "fake news," said on Truth Social that those outlets shouldn't be allowed to "FICTION and LIES."
items.summaryZh: 川普經常指責主流媒體撰寫“假新聞”，他在 Truth Social 上表示，不應該允許這些媒體“編造虛構故事和謊言”。

items.title: 卡尼表示，在川普稱歐盟提議「可笑」之後，加拿大將自行決定其合作關係。

items.titleZh: 卡尼表示，在川普稱歐盟提議「可笑」之後，加拿大將自行決定其合作關係。
items.summaryEn: U.S. President Donald Trump had described the prospect of Canada becoming the first associate member of the EU as "laughable."
